shots.title: One take: the Vesta maquette turns real, through the towers and the clouds to the silos

versions.note: Trial · one take from SH16 to SH21, 10 s, no cuts · Seedance 2.5 · 720p · Unlimited · camera from plate V3-0008 (the real dolly-in past the man), with the SH16, SH18 and SH21 edit frames as references · 0–2.5 s dolly-in on the Vesta maquette past the man with the plans, among the robotic arms · 3–4 s the studio turns into the real city and the maquette into the real Vesta towers while the camera keeps moving · 4.5–7 s push in on the tower as the fog rises until it fills the frame · 7.5–10 s the fog opens on the silos · checked frame by frame: no cut, no flicker · post: the fog brightness was evened out (it pulsed brighter, darker, brighter) and the last second had 5 repeated frames that were replaced with smooth in-between frames · note: the change from maquette to real place reads as a soft blend over about 0.7 s, not a hard morph

Trial 2 · one take from SH16 to SH21, 10 s, no cuts · Seedance 2.5 · 720p · Unlimited · camera from plate V3-0008 · references: the SH16 maquette frame, the SH17 wireframe frame, a still of the real building made from the maquette with the same floors, and the SH21 silos · 0–1.9 s dolly-in past the man · 1.9 s a scan line sweeps the studio · 2.2–3.8 s wireframe lines build the city and the mountains, then the building fills in for real from the ground up · 4.5–7 s push in on the real tower while the fog rises and fills the frame · 7.5–10 s the fog opens on the silos · the real towers keep the maquette's floors and heights · Dutch roll added in post: it builds slowly to 10° on the tower and goes back to level inside the fog, landing level on the silos (the frame is scaled up slightly while it rolls, to hide the corners) · fog brightness evened out · checked frame by frame: no cut, no flicker; the only brightness step is the scan line's own light (frames 45–48)

Trial 3 · one take from SH16 to SH21, 10 s, no cuts · Seedance 2.5 · 720p · Unlimited · camera from plate V3-0008; references: the SH16 maquette, the SH17 wireframe frame and the SH21 silos only (no real-place still: the change to real is rendered by the model) · 0–1.5 s dolly-in past the man · 1.5–2.5 s the maquette turns to glowing wireframe · 2.5–3.7 s wireframe builds the city and the mountains · 3.7–4.7 s the place becomes real at night, windows and city lights on · 4.7–6 s time-lapse to dawn, morning mist forms in the streets · 6–7.5 s the camera flies close past the windows and rises to the top of the tower · 7.5–8.3 s the mist fills the frame · 8.3–10 s out of the mist onto the silos, still tilted, then level · camera approaches like a drone/bird banking, it does not circle the building · post: graded to black and white to match the film (the model rendered the night and dawn in colour), a gentle Dutch roll up to 5° on top of the model's own bank, levelling on the silos, mist brightness evened out · checked frame by frame: no cut, no flash, no flicker, no repeated frames

Trial 4 · one take from SH16 to SH21, 10 s, no cuts · Seedance 2.5 · 720p · Unlimited · references: camera plate V3-0008, the SH16 maquette frame with the man, and the SH21 silos only (no wireframe or real-place image; the wireframe and the change to real are rendered by the model) · 0–1.3 s dolly-in past the man · 1.3–2.7 s wireframe streets, trees and mountains build out from the maquette like a scan · 2.7–3.2 s the place becomes real at night, city lights on · 3.3–4.5 s time-lapse to morning, dawn mist forms around the building · 4.5–6.3 s the camera flies in close and passes between the two towers at mid height, banking, the facades filling both sides of the frame · 6.3–8.3 s it keeps flying through morning clouds · 8.3–10 s the clouds open on the silos, then it levels · post: black-and-white grade, a gentle Dutch roll up to 4° from when we pass the man, levelling on the silos; the brightness ramp out of the gap into the clouds was smoothed · checked frame by frame: no cut, no flash, no flicker, no repeated frames

shots.title: Silo roof dissolves into the iris

versions.note: One take covering SH17–SH19 (the change from black and white to colour), 10 s, no cuts · Seedance 2.5 · 720p · Unlimited · references: camera plate V3-0009 (the eye pulling back to the engineer in red) and the silo top view only · 0–1.5 s top view of the silo roof in black and white, the camera descends · 1.5–2.3 s the ribs become the iris, the opening becomes the pupil and the colour blooms out of it · 2.3–3.3 s macro of her eye, pulling back to the plate's framing with no jump · 3.3–4.7 s she is in an engineering office high in a glass tower, models and drawings around her · 4.7–6.5 s the camera goes back out through the glass: we see her behind the glass with the clouds and the sun reflected, the flare grows and the reflected sky fills the frame · 6.5–7.3 s into the clouds · 7.3–10 s the towers rise out of a sea of golden clouds, the sun behind them throwing long rays through the cloud · post: the brightness in the clouds evened out · checked frame by frame: no cut, no flash, no flicker, no repeated frames · notes: at 4.7–5.2 s she fades into the reflection on the glass (it reads like a glass double exposure); the towers are generic, not the real Sulaymaniyah skyline
